info.title: Order service events
info.description:
Facts the order service publishes about orders. Consumers: fulfilment, loyalty, analytics.

Consumers must: (1) deduplicate on eventId, because delivery is at-least-once; (2) apply an event only when its orderRevision is higher than the last one applied for that order, and drop it otherwise; (3) ignore fields and event types they do not recognise; (4) never rely on order across different orders; (5) own the dead-letter queue for their consumer group.

Versioning: within a version only optional fields are added. A breaking change ships as a new event version, published alongside the old one until the old one's sunset date, agreed with its consumers.

production.description: Placeholder; the platform team supplies the real bootstrap servers.

orderLifecycle.description: Every state change of an order, in the order it happened for that order.
orderLifecycle.x-ordering: Ordered per orderId: OrderPlaced, OrderPaid and OrderCancelled for one order arrive in the order the order service committed them. No order across orders and no global order. A retry can redeliver an earlier event; consumers compare orderRevision.
orderLifecycle.x-delivery: at-least-once; duplicates come from producer retries, consumer rebalances and replays
orderLifecycle.x-replay: A consumer group can reset its offset to any point in the last 7 days.
orderLifecycle.x-dead-letter: After 5 failed attempts [assumption] a consumer parks the message on <consumer-group>.orders.order-lifecycle.v1.dlq. Owner per consumer group: to confirm.

ordersLegacy.description: Today's topic, carrying OrderPlaced v1 unchanged until its sunset date. Nothing new is added here.
ordersLegacy.x-partition-key: to confirm: the current key on this topic is not stated
ordersLegacy.x-ordering: Unchanged from today; no ordering promise is added. No global order.
ordersLegacy.x-replay: A consumer group can reset its offset to any point in the last 7 days.

OrderPlacedV2.name: OrderPlacedV2
OrderPlacedV2.title: Order placed (v2)
OrderPlacedV2.summary: A customer placed an order. Not yet paid.
OrderPlacedV2.description: Event-carried state: what the order contains. No delivery address: nobody acts on an unpaid order's address.

OrderPaid.name: OrderPaid
OrderPaid.title: Order paid
OrderPaid.summary: Payment for an order succeeded. Replaces the requested CreateShipment.
OrderPaid.description: Event-carried state: everything fulfilment needs to start picking and loyalty needs to award points, so neither calls the order API.

OrderCancelled.name: OrderCancelled
OrderCancelled.title: Order cancelled
OrderCancelled.summary: A customer or support agent cancelled an order before dispatch.
OrderCancelled.description: Notification: ids and who cancelled. Fulfilment stops picking; loyalty reverses the points it awarded for this orderId.

OrderPlacedV1.name: OrderPlacedV1
OrderPlacedV1.title: Order placed (v1, deprecated)
OrderPlacedV1.summary: Today's event, documented as-is. Unchanged until sunset.

customerEmail.x-pii: no consumer named; not carried in v2

total.description: Major units as a decimal (42.50). Replaced by totalAmount in v2.

placedAt.description: Local time with no zone, as published today.

eventId.description: Unique per event; identical on every redelivery and replay.

occurredAt.description: When it happened, UTC, RFC 3339 with Z.

causationId.description: eventId or request id that caused this event.

OrderRevision.description: Increases by 1 on every change to this order.

TotalAmount.description: Order total in minor units (pence): 42.50 GBP is 4250.
